title: Exam 2
subtitle: Cardiovascular Function, Perfusion & Gas Exchange

practiceExams.note: The blueprint's topic table lists 42 questions plus 6 dosage calculation out of 75 total. The remaining questions are spread across the Exam 2 topics in the same proportions as the blueprint.

outcomes: Perform focused assessment of cardiac and respiratory systems
Recognize common disease processes, pathophysiology, and evidence-based nursing care
Prioritize client care: ABCs, perfusion, risk for deterioration, medications
Recognize and respond to a deteriorating patient; evaluate teaching
Promote patient safety; recognize cues and filter key findings from noise
Provide patient-centered communication and education; analyze cues
Generate solutions: select interventions and plan safe, evidence-based care
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams: procedures, provider communication, diagnostics

objectives.title: Gas Exchange
items: Explain the structure, function, and physiology of ventilation and perfusion
Examine assessment findings related to cardiopulmonary function
Discuss clinical outcomes related to alterations in ventilation and perfusion
Explore oxygen therapies and related potential complications
Explore nursing actions used to improve oxygenation

objectives.title: Cardiovascular Function & Perfusion
items: Explain the pathophysiology for alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion
Explore epidemiological and etiological risk factors
Describe the impact on a client's overall health
Differentiate the clinical presentation of these alterations
Explore the role of the nurse when caring for these clients
Apply the nursing process through clinical judgment functions
